```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```


https://speciationgenomics.github.io/ADMIXTURE/
converting vcf files to .bed
```{sh, eval = FALSE}
mkdir outputs/106
module load plink
plink --vcf outputs/101.2/pruned-nwrk.vcf --make-bed --out outputs/106/pruned-nwrk --double-id --allow-extra-chr
awk '{$1="0";print $0}' outputs/106/pruned-nwrk.bim > outputs/106/pruned-nwrk.bim.tmp
mv outputs/106/pruned-nwrk.bim.tmp outputs/106/pruned-nwrk.bim
```

Doing cross validation for Ks 1-5
```{sh, eval = FALSE}
for K in 1 2 3 4 5; \
do admixture --cv pruned-nwrk.bed $K | tee log${K}.out; done

grep -h CV log*.out
```

rerunning with Ks 5-10
```{sh, eval = FALSE}
for K in 6 7 8 9 10; \
do admixture --cv pruned-nwrk.bed $K | tee log${K}.out; done

grep -h CV log*.out
grep -h CV log*.out | cut -f 3,4 -d ' '  | perl -pe 's/://g' | perl -pe s'/\(|\)//g' > scores.txt 
```



```{r}
scores <- read_delim("outputs/106/scores.txt", col_names = c("K", "Cross-Validation Error")) %>%
  mutate(K = as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", K))) %>%
  arrange(K)

ggplot(scores, aes(x = K, y = `Cross-Validation Error`)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scores$K) +
  ggtitle("newarkensis CVs") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))

```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Now actually running admixture using CVs previously calculated
NV17-19 had similar low scores at 2 and 3 but 3 is slightly lower
```{sh, eval = FALSE}
srun -t 02:00:00 -p bmh --account=millermrgrp --mem=16G --nodes=1  --ntasks-per-node=1  admixture pruned-nwrk.bed 5
srun -t 02:00:00 -p bmh --account=millermrgrp --mem=16G --nodes=1  --ntasks-per-node=1  admixture pruned-nwrk_17_19.bed 2
srun -t 02:00:00 -p bmh --account=millermrgrp --mem=16G --nodes=1  --ntasks-per-node=1  admixture pruned-nwrk_17_19.bed 3
srun -t 02:00:00 -p bmh --account=millermrgrp --mem=16G --nodes=1  --ntasks-per-node=1  admixture pruned_nwrk_west.bed 2
```

Plotting admixture results
```{r}
tbl <- read.table("outputs/106/pruned-nwrk.5.Q")
barplot(t(as.matrix(tbl)), col=rainbow(3), xlab="Individual #", ylab="Ancestry",border=NA, main = "All newarkensis admixture")
```
